title: ZPK Digital ID Gemma 4 Good Submission Package
subtitle: Android-first identity registration and recovery app, video, evidence, and submission files
description: ZPK Digital ID is a local-first Android identity wallet for Guatemalan citizens. This dataset contains the submission ZIP, final narrated video, writeup, evidence, and reproducibility files for the Gemma 4 Good Hackathon submission. It uses synthetic data only and includes no API keys.
